content: Preventive maintenance inspection on motor M-201 SKF6310 bearing. Asset flagged for scheduled PM at 8000-hour service interval. Vibration reading 0.9 mm/s RMS, temperature 36 deg C, kurtosis 1.8. All readings within ISO Stage 0 healthy range. No spall patterns detected in frequency spectrum. No BPFO or BPFI families elevated. Bearing visually inspected and found in excellent condition with no pitting, scoring, or cage deformation. Action taken: re-lubrication with Mobilux EP2, torque check on motor mounting bolts, verification of shaft alignment. Post-inspection readings confirmed baseline stability at 0.8 mm/s RMS. Recommendation: next inspection at 18-month interval or on vibration trend trigger. Lessons learned: proactive PM on healthy assets prevents unplanned failures. Lubrication at this interval maintains bearing health. Baseline readings serve as reference for anomaly detection calibration.
